_README: Sample eval suite for the general product, written for the general test of 2026-11-11 (docs/general-test-20261111.md). It runs against a test install holding nine public manuals filed under three ranges: tesla (Model 3, Model Y, Wall Connector), microsoft (Surface Pro and Surface Pro 2, Surface Pro 3, Surface 3) and huawei (WATCH GT 4, WATCH GT 5 and GT 5 Pro, WiFi AX3); the report lists the files and where they come from. The documents are not in this repository. A customer's own suite replaces this file. Schema per case: q; outcome: answered | clarify | rejected; keywords_all (case-insensitive substrings that MUST appear); reference (ground truth for the LLM grader, with its page); grade: true enables LLM grading; new_session: true starts a fresh conversation (omit to test a follow-up against the previous case); product scopes retrieval (here a range key); layer as in eval.py; requires_deepseek skips the case without a key.

cases.q: Which has the bigger front trunk, the Model 3 or the Model Y Performance, and by how much?
cases.reference: Model 3 front trunk: 3.1 cu ft (88 L) (Model 3 Owner's Manual, Dimensions, p.228). Model Y Premium/Performance front trunk: 4.1 cu ft (116 L) (Model Y Owner's Manual, Dimensions, p.243). The Model Y Performance's is bigger by 1.0 cu ft (28 L). Source: Model 3 manual PDF p.230; Model Y manual PDF p.245.

cases.q: What is the ground clearance of the Model 3 Performance?
cases.reference: Model 3 Performance ground clearance: 5.0 in (128 mm). The rear-wheel drive/Long Range figure is 5.4 in (138 mm), from a separate table. Source: Model 3 manual PDF p.229.

cases.q: And the rear-wheel drive one?
cases.reference: Model 3 Rear-Wheel Drive/Long Range ground clearance: 5.4 in (138 mm). Source: Model 3 manual PDF p.229.

cases.q: What is the maximum towing capacity of a Model Y 7-seater on 19-inch wheels with 7 people on board?
cases.reference: Model Y 7-seater on 19-inch wheels with 7 passengers: maximum towing capacity 2,000 lbs (907 kg), maximum tongue weight 200 lbs (91 kg). Source: Model Y manual PDF p.112.

cases.q: The charge cable is stuck in my Model 3's charge port and the handle button and the app won't release it. How do I get it out?
cases.reference: 1) Make sure Model 3 is not charging (Stop Charging on the charging screen). 2) Open the rear trunk. 3) Pull the charge port release cable downwards to unlatch the cable. 4) Pull the charge cable out. Never pull the release cable while pulling the charge cable; pull the release first. Use it only when the usual methods fail. Source: Model 3 manual PDF p.190-191.

cases.q: My Wall Connector's light keeps blinking red three times, then pauses. What's wrong and what should I check?
cases.reference: Three red blinks: high temperature detected; charging limited or disabled. Make sure the Wall Connector is on Wi-Fi with the latest firmware; check the faceplate and handle for excess warmth; have an electrician check the conductor size and terminal block torque; update firmware through commissioning if needed; then contact support. Source: Wall Connector manual PDF p.59.

cases.q: What range of maximum current can the installer set on the Wall Connector, and what's the smallest stranded cable allowed between it and the breaker?
cases.reference: Any maximum current from 6 A to 32 A can be set during commissioning. Stranded cable smaller than 4 mm2 must not be used between the Wall Connector and the breaker. Source: Wall Connector manual PDF p.12.

cases.q: What is the 0 to 60 mph acceleration time of the Model Y Performance?
cases.reference: Not in the documents: the owner's manuals give no 0-60 mph time. The bot must say so, not give a figure. Source: absent from both manuals.

cases.q: It won't charge. What should I do?
cases.reference: Vague: the chat covers two cars and a Wall Connector. The bot should ask which product (or what happens) before answering. Source: -.

cases.q: My Model Y's liftgate hits my garage ceiling. How do I make it open lower, and how can I undo that later?
cases.reference: Pause the liftgate at the wanted height using the touchscreen (or move it there by hand), then save it by following the touchscreen prompts or holding the button on the underside of the liftgate until a chime. To undo: Controls > Service > Remove Saved Locations. Source: Model Y manual PDF p.33-34.

cases.q: How is the kickstand on the Surface Pro 3 different from the one on the Surface Pro 2?
cases.reference: Surface Pro 2: two kickstand positions (desk and lap); the original Surface Pro has one. Surface Pro 3: any position down to 30 degrees (multi-position). Source: Surface Pro/Pro 2 guide p.7; Surface Pro 3 guide 'The Kickstand'.

cases.q: What screen size, resolution and aspect ratio does the Surface Pro 3 have?
cases.reference: Surface Pro 3: 12-inch touchscreen, 3:2 aspect ratio, 2160 x 1440. Source: Surface Pro 3 guide p.7.

cases.q: And the Surface 3?
cases.reference: Surface 3: 10.8-inch ClearType full HD display, 3:2, 1920 x 1280. Source: Surface 3 guide PDF p.8.

cases.q: Which comes with the more powerful power supply, the Surface Pro 2 or the Surface Pro 3? Give the wattages.
cases.reference: Surface Pro 2 (and Surface Pro): 48-watt power supply. Surface Pro 3: 36-watt power supply (with a USB charging port). The Pro 2's is more powerful. Source: Surface Pro/Pro 2 guide p.7; Surface Pro 3 guide p.7.

cases.q: My Surface Pen got unpaired from my Surface Pro 3. How do I pair it again?
cases.reference: Settings > Change PC settings > PC and devices > Bluetooth, make sure Bluetooth is on; hold the pen's top button until the light in the middle of the pen clip flashes; select the pen in the list and Pair. Source: Surface Pro 3 guide PDF p.102.

cases.q: The pen for my Surface Pro 3 no longer writes, erases or right-clicks, and it won't pair either. What's the likely cause?
cases.reference: The two size 319 lithium coin cell batteries in the top of the pen need replacing (the AAAA battery is separate). See Troubleshoot Surface Pen on Surface.com for how. Source: Surface Pro 3 guide PDF p.102.

cases.q: Can I upgrade my Surface 3 to Windows 11?
cases.reference: Not in the documents: the guide covers Windows 8.1 only. The bot must not say yes or no. Source: absent.

cases.q: It keeps disconnecting. What should I do?
cases.reference: Vague: which device and what disconnects (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, pen, Type Cover)? Should ask back. Source: -.

cases.q: How do I connect my Surface 3 to a TV that has an HDMI port?
cases.reference: You need an HDMI cable plus a Mini DisplayPort to HD AV adapter, or an HDMI to Mini DisplayPort cable. Connect the cable to the TV's HDMI port, the other end to the adapter or the Surface's Mini DisplayPort, the adapter into the Mini DisplayPort; then Devices > Project to choose what shows. Source: Surface 3 guide PDF p.29-30.

cases.q: What memory and storage options does the Surface 3 come with?
cases.reference: 2 GB RAM with 64 GB storage, or 4 GB RAM with 128 GB storage. Source: Surface 3 guide PDF p.9.

cases.q: Can I take an ECG or use diving mode on the HUAWEI WATCH GT 5, or do I need the GT 5 Pro?
cases.reference: Both ECG measurement and diving mode are only on the HUAWEI WATCH GT 5 Pro (ECG also only in certain markets). The GT 5 does not have them. Source: GT 5 guide PDF p.27 (ECG) and diving mode section.

cases.q: My WATCH GT 4 is rated 5 ATM. What does that mean, can I dive 50 metres with it?
cases.reference: 5 ATM (ISO 22810:2010) means it withstands simulated 50 m static water pressure at room temperature for 10 minutes; it does NOT mean water resistance at 50 m depth. Fine for pools, the beach, rain and splashes. So no, not a 50 m dive. Source: GT 4 guide PDF p.48.

cases.q: What should I do with it after swimming?
cases.reference: Clean and dry it promptly, remove water stains from the surfaces and all holes, and use the device's drainage feature. Source: GT 4 guide PDF p.48.

cases.q: Which HUAWEI WiFi AX3 model has NFC, the WS7100 or the WS7200?
cases.reference: The WS7200 has an NFC detection area; the WS7100 diagram shows none. Source: AX3 quick start PDF p.3-4.

cases.q: The light on my HUAWEI WiFi AX3 router stays steady red. What does that mean and what should I check?
cases.reference: Steady red: not connected to the network (Internet). Causes: loose cable or connection error (check the cable), or a broadband network error (contact the broadband carrier). Configure the network settings (Step 2) if not done. Source: AX3 quick start PDF p.5, p.9.

cases.q: How do I restore my HUAWEI WiFi AX3 router to factory settings?
cases.reference: Power the router and wait for it to start; press RESET with a pin for more than two seconds until the indicator goes out; wait for the restart; a red indicator means it is restored; configure it again. Source: AX3 quick start PDF p.10.

cases.q: How do I add a second HUAWEI router to my WiFi AX3 network wirelessly using the H button?
cases.reference: Place the add-on router (new or factory reset) within one metre of the configured AX3 and power it; when the AX3's indicator starts to flash, press the AX3's H button; wait until the add-on router's indicator shows it is connected. Supported: WS5800, WS7100, WS7200. Source: AX3 quick start PDF p.11.

cases.q: What is the maximum Wi-Fi speed of the HUAWEI WiFi AX3 in Mbps?
cases.reference: Not in the documents: the quick start gives no Mbps figure. Must not invent one. Source: absent.

cases.q: How do I reset it?
cases.reference: Vague: reset which product (a watch or the router)? Should ask back. Source: -.

cases.q: How do I charge my WATCH GT 4, and how do I know when it's full?
cases.reference: Connect the charging cradle and cable, connect the adapter to power, rest the watch on the cradle with the metal contacts aligned until the charging icon shows. Full when the icon shows 100%; charging then stops automatically. Source: GT 4 guide PDF p.34.
